proposedInterfaces.name: GoalAuthoritySubjectKey
proposedInterfaces.shape: repositoryId + grantId + subjectRef; exact stable identifiers, not natural-language goal similarity

proposedInterfaces.name: GoalAuthorityActionFacts
proposedInterfaces.shape: actor identifier, operation identifier, normalized resource identifier, requested deliverable identifiers and explicit Work Item/parent narrowing facts
proposedInterfaces.semantics: Supplied inputs for conditional evaluation; no host identity is authenticated by constructing these Rust values.

proposedInterfaces.name: ResolvedGoalAuthorityFacts
proposedInterfaces.shape: P1 source bytes; observed current source version/digest; complete version-chain observation; stable subject termination state; issuer/actor/currentness observations; complete parent narrowing chain
proposedInterfaces.semantics: A fact snapshot for evaluation, not a trusted grant token. Unknown, conflicting or incomplete required facts reject eligibility. The production default never manufactures this snapshot from actor/authoritySource strings.

proposedInterfaces.name: CurrentGoalAuthorityResolver::resolve_current
requirements: A future production adapter must independently bind the executing repository, stable grant/subject, authenticated issuer/delegation and actual actor context.
It must resolve the current head and stable termination evidence consistently, distinguish version replacement from subject termination, and report missing/forked/stale/unknown state.
Observation timestamps and Runtime binary identity alone are insufficient.
All source writers and consumers must eventually share a proven ordering/fencing contract. P2a does not choose a storage database or claim this contract exists.
P2a's concrete production default returns Unsupported. There is no environment-variable, config-file, serde field or arbitrary string that selects a fixture provider.

proposedInterfaces.name: assess_goal_authority
proposedInterfaces.signature: fn assess_goal_authority(facts: &ResolvedGoalAuthorityFacts, reference: &GoalAuthorityReference, action: &GoalAuthorityActionFacts, sample: ClockSample) -> Result<GoalAuthorityAssessment, GoalAuthorityAssessmentError>
proposedInterfaces.result: EligibleUnderSuppliedFacts { source_digest, reference_digest, effective_window } or a structured rejection. Neither variant is a Runtime action permit or admission receipt.
proposedInterfaces.purity: No filesystem, provider, clock acquisition, native lifecycle, grant persistence, permission mutation or decision recording.

assessmentRules: Normalize source/reference through P1; preserve original descriptive bytes and digests.
Require exact repository/grant/subject identity and explicit deliverable coverage; unknown coverage fails. Do not infer coverage from prose or stitch grants.

Require the supplied issuer, actor, current-head, termination and parent-chain observations to be complete and acceptable; their acceptance is conditional input evaluation, not authentication performed by this module.
Intersect source constraints and all explicit narrowing; initial explicit widening rejects. Unknown resource/constraint semantics reject as unsupported rather than creating a policy DSL.
effectiveStart=max(source start, complete parent starts, WI start); effectiveEnd=min(current source end, complete parent ends, fixed cap). InheritSource is finite because source is finite.
Use start <= now < end at integer-millisecond precision; nonrepresentable submillisecond inputs reject, with no rounding or grace.
Stable completed/revoked/replaced subjects and terminal WIs never revive. Ordinary source-version replacement alone does not terminate a stable active subject.
No current production handler consumes EligibleUnderSuppliedFacts. No governanceProfile opt-in, capability advertisement, active grant or migration is introduced in P2a.

fixtureBoundary.providerLocation: Inline #[cfg(test)] module in authority.rs; integration-test-only helpers, if needed, stay in the test file. No production fixture provider or injection switch.
fixtureBoundary.effect: Test-owned counter only, not Contract/Summary/receipt mutation or a real action.
fixtureBoundary.freshSequence: At each simulated step: resolve fixture facts anew; obtain Clock::sample; observe the original MonotonicBudget; require positive budget; assess; then increment the test counter only if conditionally eligible.
fixtureBoundary.afterWait: Inject an explicit fixture barrier before the final sample/assessment. It does not represent a real lifecycle or cross-checkout source lock.
fixtureBoundary.onError: SamplingGap, rollback, resolver error/Unsupported, rejected assessment or zero budget causes zero new simulated effects. Never fall back to cached remaining_millis or replenish an existing operation budget.
fixtureBoundary.assurance: Fixture success proves the supplied deterministic scenario only. It is not production issuer verification, a durable revocation barrier, CLI/MCP admission parity or full-feature acceptance.

tests.name: offline_exact_goal_and_deliverable_coverage
assertions: same repository/grant/subject with explicit coverage is conditionally eligible
different goal, absent deliverable coverage and grant stitching reject

tests.name: offline_unknown_identity_head_termination_or_parent_facts_reject
assertions: valid-looking issuer/actor strings alone do not satisfy required fact observations
unknown/conflicting/stale/forked head or incomplete parent/termination facts reject

tests.name: offline_narrowing_and_finite_windows
assertions: explicit child expansion rejects
effective start is maximum and end minimum
inherit follows supplied current source while fixed cap remains unchanged
unsupported constraints reject

tests.name: offline_integer_millisecond_boundaries
assertions: notBefore-1ms rejects; notBefore permits; expiresAt-1ms permits; expiresAt rejects
missing/null/unbounded/malformed/unsupported submillisecond validity rejects via P1 normalization

tests.name: offline_current_version_and_stable_termination
assertions: ordinary version replacement is distinct from grant termination
old head cannot authorize a fresh simulated step
terminal subjects cannot be revived by a later version missing its termination field

tests.name: fixture_fresh_sample_after_wait_and_no_cache_fallback
assertions: expiry advanced at fixture barrier yields effectCount=0
positive cached remaining_millis cannot override a sampling failure or zero observe result
resolver/clock calls occur anew for each simulated step

tests.name: fixture_original_budget_not_refilled
assertions: source extension may affect future new steps but does not replenish the current operation budget
wall/monotonic rollback and stalled UTC consume/reject according to P1 behavior
no sleeps or persisted remaining-budget replay

tests.name: public_default_resolver_is_unsupported
assertions: default production-facing resolution returns Unsupported
public offline assessment is not accepted by any Runtime write handler and creates no native decision/admission receipt
no test-provider selector exists in production configuration

tests.name: legacy_regression_and_evidence_preservation
assertions: reuse existing legacy Contract/AuthorityEvidence tests and full workspace verification
no Protocol/Contract fields or production entry behavior are changed
P1 success/failure/unknown/truncation history remains immutable
